title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-28 07:36:56 最新章节：第3015章 骤闻扑面金风急
content_zh:
在无尽的荒月大陆西南边陲，连绵起伏的大青山，连成一道起伏不绝的纵横暗色交错线条。
此时已是落日西下，黑夜渐浓，山脚下的村庄里已陆续亮了昏暗的油灯，村头的几棵老槐树，被风吹的树叶哗哗作响。
不时有几声犬吠从村中传出很远，这时会引起更多的犬吠附和响起，直至慢慢消停无声……
油灯照着屋内的干裂的土墙，摇曳着几个模糊的人影映在墙上，斜斜的或长或短。
“孩他娘，这事就这么定了吧！
当兵吃粮，至少饿不死，若是命大混好了，兴许还能有个出息！”
坐在门边靠着门框的老者面容苍老，常年的劳作使得皮肤粗糙，坐着的背有些驼，手里拿着一个烟袋。
烟杆下面坠着一个泛黄发黑的烟袋，说完一句后，拿起吸吮着。
“啪哒，啪哒……”
在沉静的屋内却显示声音很响、很脆。
“可是，老五他……他只有十四岁啊，年龄这么小”
月光如水，夜若清凉！
夜半，堂屋门一声轻响，兄弟俩不再说话。
老三的腿前些年劳作伤了，落下残疾，出去也不能做得什么。
“嗯！”
“那以后李家兴许就老五能光宗耀祖了！”
其实李伟、李言对村外也不是一无所知，像村里去城里卖野兽肉或毛皮，或去城中购买东西回来村民都会说上一些。
三哥李伟前些年却因下田耕地时，不小心被耕具伤了脚踝，因家中银两不足耽误了寻找郎中日子，落下了个跛足。
这是一个半大小子，看身架约有十六、七岁，却有些瘦弱，面庞黝黑，相貌十分普通，身着有好几处破洞的旧粗布衣服。
李言随着年龄增长，也开始明着跟随捕猎队伍进山，慢慢熟悉了一些野兽的习性，一点点参与了大人们的捕猎。

说完，老者又闷头“啪哒啪达”抽着烟，屋内老妇低头继续啜泣。
“嗯！.三哥，地里活你多干些，爹娘年纪大了。”
他们这是边陲城镇，向南就是孟国，边境处的两国不时就要打上一场，当兵上疆场几率还是很大，尤其是这几年时不时就有战事爆发。
“老五，三哥这”
“也许我以后能混个将军什么的，那时把你们都接去享福，那就风光了。”
但是由于这两年闹蝗灾，主要的粮食收成大大减少，家中每顿只能吃个半饱，已不似以前那般健壮，身体消瘦起来。
一段时间后，屋外那道身影站了起来，转身走进屋内。
虽然有村长带领一些人偶尔去山里猎兽，但是毕竟深处是去不得的，也只能在外围偶尔猎到一些野鸡、野兔，都不够分的。
“爹，娘，你们不用担心了，村里很多人都出去了，现在家里的收成也只够勉强吃饱。
四姐李小珠也亦找好了婆家，只是由于这两年蝗灾，婆家本身也不是富裕之户，这样一时却也凑不齐彩礼来娶。
屋内半跪着扶着娘亲的李伟歉意抬起头来，看向了李言。
“好，只要有我在，爹娘就饿不着。”
朝内文胜武衰，导致周边国家蠢蠢欲动，不时有兵乱纷起，近几年不止这一个方向有战乱，其他方向边境也是同样有战事爆发。
他们这个离县城有二百多里的山村，村里一共就十二、三家，入伍当兵的多年不会有一个。
而当地防军碍于当今皇上以文道、德经制天下的法章，又不能强行征兵。
李言兄妹五人，大姐、二姐分别在他十岁、十二岁时已远嫁了。
所以，这几年只要入伍参军，就可以先拿到一笔费用给到家人，其实就是安家费，以作激起参军热潮。
少年名叫李言，平时少言寡语，自小跟着村里的老秀才同一帮年龄差不多大的孩子一起读过六、七年私塾。
“这连续两年蝗灾，不要说咱家，村里有一大半的家里都没了粮食，能进城做工的做工，远行的远行，当兵的当兵。
继而，屋内又沉寂下去，很久之后，李老汉把烟袋在门槛上磕了几下说道。
content_en:
On the southwest border of the endless Desolate Moon Continent, the rolling green mountains form an endless criss-crossing dark line.
At this time, the sun was setting in the west, and the night was getting darker. Dim oil lamps were successively lit in the villages at the foot of the mountain. The leaves of several old locust trees at the head of the village were rustling in the wind.
From time to time, a few barks of dogs could be heard far away from the village, which would then cause more barks to echo, until they slowly died down...
The oil lamp shines on the cracked earth wall in the house, and several vague figures are reflected on the wall, slanting, long or short.
“My dear, let’s just settle this matter!
As a soldier, if you eat enough food, at least you won't starve to death. If your fate is better, you may still have a future! "
The old man sitting next to the door and leaning against the door frame has an old face, and his skin is rough from years of toil. His back is a little hunched when he is sitting, and he is holding a pipe in his hand.
There was a yellowed and black cigarette bag hanging under the cigarette rod. After saying a sentence, he picked it up and sucked on it.
"Pah, pah..."
In the quiet room, the sound was very loud and crisp.
"But Lao Wu...he is only fourteen years old, so young."
The moonlight is like water and the night is cool!
In the middle of the night, there was a light knock on the hall door, and the two brothers stopped talking.
The third child’s leg was injured at work a few years ago and became disabled, so he couldn’t do much when he went out.
"Yeah!"
"Then the fifth child of the Li family may be able to bring glory to the family!"
In fact, Li Wei and Li Yan didn't know anything about the outside of the village. For example, when the villagers went to the city to sell beast meat or furs, or when they went to the city to buy things, the villagers would tell them something about it.
The third brother, Li Wei, accidentally injured his ankle on a plowing tool a few years ago when he was plowing in the fields. Due to the lack of money at home, the search for a doctor was delayed and he became lame.
He was a half-grown boy, about sixteen or seventeen years old, somewhat thin, with a dark face and a very ordinary appearance. He was wearing old coarse cloth clothes with several holes in them.
As Li Yan grew older, he also began to follow the hunting team into the mountains. He gradually became familiar with the habits of some wild animals, and gradually participated in the adults' hunting.
After saying that, the old man kept his head down and smoked a cigarette. The old woman in the room lowered her head and continued to sob.
"Well! Third brother, you should work more in the fields. My parents are getting older."
They are a border town, with Bangladesh to the south. The two countries on the border will fight each other from time to time, and the chance of serving as soldiers on the battlefield is still very high, especially since wars have broken out from time to time in the past few years.
"Lao Wu, Third Brother this"
"Maybe I can become a general or something in the future, and then I can take you all to enjoy the blessings. That would be great."
However, due to the locust plague in the past two years, the main grain harvest has been greatly reduced. The family can only eat half a meal at a time, and is no longer as strong as before, and the body has become thinner.
After a while, the figure outside the house stood up, turned around and walked into the house.
Although the village chief led some people to occasionally hunt animals in the mountains, after all, they were not allowed to go deep, and they could only occasionally hunt pheasants and hares in the periphery, which were not enough.
"Father, mother, you don't have to worry. Many people in the village have gone out, and now the harvest at home is only enough to barely feed us.
The fourth sister, Li Xiaozhu, has also found her husband's family. However, due to the locust plague in the past two years, her husband's family itself is not a wealthy family, so they cannot raise the betrothal gift to marry her.
Li Wei, who was half-kneeling in the room and supporting his mother, raised his head apologetically and looked at Li Yan.
"Okay, as long as I'm here, my parents won't be hungry. "
The civil superiority of the country and the decline of military power have caused surrounding countries to be ready to take action, and wars have broken out from time to time. In recent years, not only have wars occurred in this direction, but wars have also broken out in other directions on the border.
They are a mountain village more than 200 miles away from the county seat. There are only twelve or three families in the village, and not one of them has enlisted in the army for many years.
However, the local defense army cannot forcefully recruit troops due to the current emperor's laws and regulations that control the world with culture and morality.
Li Yan has five brothers and sisters, the eldest sister and the second sister.He was married away when he was ten and twelve years old respectively.
Therefore, in recent years, as long as you join the army, you can get a sum of money to give to your family, which is actually a settlement allowance, to stimulate the enthusiasm for joining the army.
The young man's name is Li Yan. He is usually taciturn. He has been attending a private school for six or seven years with an old scholar in the village and a group of children of similar age.
"In the past two consecutive years of locust plague, not to mention our family, more than half of the families in the village have lost food. Those who can go to the city to work, those who can travel far away, and those who can serve as soldiers.
Then, the room fell silent again. After a long time, Old Man Li knocked his pipe on the threshold a few times and said.
